messages.content: Which comes before column C?
Column B comes before column C.
Which comes first numerically: 12 or 21?
12 comes first numerically before 21.
Which is earlier in the day: 09:30 or 14:00?
09:30 is earlier in the day than 14:00.
Which comes first alphabetically: apple or table?
Apple comes first alphabetically.
Which comes after the letter M?
The letter that comes after M is N.
Which value is a percentage: 40% or 40kg?
40% is a percentage.
Which item is usually used to write: a pen or a shelf?
A pen is usually used to write.
Which number is even: 13 or 18?
18 is even.
Which has more sides: a triangle or a square?
A square has more sides than a triangle.
If a list has five items and two are removed, how many remain?
Three items remain.
Which date comes earlier: 2026-01-05 or 2026-01-15?
2026-01-05 comes earlier.
If a clock shows 6:00, how many full hours until 9:00?
There are 3 full hours from 6:00 to 9:00.
Which word has more letters: paper or spreadsheet?
Spreadsheet has more letters than paper.
Which is larger: 1,000 or 100?
1,000 is larger than 100.
Which number is closer to 100: 95 or 80?
95 is closer to 100 than 80.
Which format is more specific: year or year-month-day?
The year-month-day format is more specific.
If text has extra spaces removed, is it shorter or unchanged in spacing?
Text has extra spaces removed, so it is shorter in spacing.
If a document is renamed, does its name change?
Yes, if a document is renamed, its name changes.
If a schedule has morning and afternoon blocks, how many blocks are named?
Two blocks are named: "morning" and "afternoon."
Which direction is opposite of left?
Right
If a row has ten cells and one is selected, how many are not selected?
Nine cells are not selected.
Which comes after Tuesday?
Wednesday comes after Tuesday.
If a list has duplicate values, are some values repeated?
Yes, if a list has duplicate values, some values are repeated.
Which word is plural: file or files?
"Files" is plural.
If a receipt lists three prices, what operation finds the total?
Addition finds the total.
Which is usually smaller: a paragraph or a sentence?
A sentence is usually smaller than a paragraph.
Which is greater: 15 percent or 25 percent?
25 percent is greater than 15 percent.
If a list is sorted ascending, should smaller numbers appear first?
Yes, if a list is sorted ascending, smaller numbers should appear first.
If a word is copied twice, how many copies are made?
If a word is copied twice, three copies are made.
If a file is moved into a folder, where is the file located?
The file is located in the folder.
